$schema: Damage of Eternity — canonical damage model v1

baseDamage.note: Base damage is a rolled stat shown on the weapon in-game; a manual user input in the app. Per-type ranges are disregarded in the equation (owner ruling 2026-10-21). Known anchors only: 130 roll = 2 perks + element; 150 roll = 1 perk + element.

combinationFrequencies_MaxTier4Pool.note: Computed from independent rolls and verified. Sword builds run 3 pools (Stab is conditional, not a roll): none 27.74%, one 44.61%, two 23.55%, all three 4.10%. Ranged: max 2 proc perks per shot — 3- and 4-proc combos impossible on one shot.

confidence: Formula + values: community-tested Oct 2026 (Dungeons Demystified), single-source family; perk pool/scaling: Forsaken Planet wiki. Every field carries its own confidence where it matters.
display: Three numbers only — Floor (no procs) / Expected per hit / Ceiling (all procs) WITH the ceiling's frequency attached. NO DPS anywhere (no attack-rate data exists). In-game display rounds multipliers to nearest tenth and damage to nearest whole; the app shows exact values.

exoPerks.currency: Crystal Hunt missions (name contradicted: Exo Crystals vs EXO Points — UNKNOWN)

perks.name: Power / Pullback
perks.note: Slide groups Power+Pullback as one 0.5 factor (x1.5). Narration '1.3 and 1.5' is ambiguous. Pullback presumed bow-draw related — UNCONFIRMED. Per-level values UNKNOWN.

perks.name: EXO Criticals (slide: Critical/Impale)
perks.note: Co-triggers with weapon Criticals for x9. True in-game name unconfirmed.

chain: exoCrit factor ((3 + predatorA + predatorB) on proc, else 1)
weaponCrit factor ((3 + predatorA + predatorB) on proc, else 1)
formula.groupingRule: Identical rings ADD inside their factor; different sources MULTIPLY. Order is grouping + priority rules, not sequence.
formula.text: DAMAGE = BASE x (1+Sundering+Sundering) x (1+Scout's+Scout's) x (1+AttackPower) x (1+Power/Pullback) x (1+Stab) x Fire x Explosions x EXOCritFactor x WeaponCritFactor x Might x Pierce x Handling x EnemyZone

handling.grip: Owner-confirmed 2:1 — two hands vs one hand on a two-handed weapon (matches testers' x2 handling for spear/hammer/greatsword). Axe handling is CONTRADICTED in the source (slide x2 vs narration x3 one-hand / x6 two-hand).
handling.longsword: Two hands required for full benefit

interactions: Fire overrides other elements/Slowing on projectiles; a lit crossbow bolt loses its crit to fire-only.
Ranged: max 2 proc perks per shot.
One status effect at a time per enemy; a new status replaces the old.
Backstab (Shadow Strike) does NOT stack with Scout's Signet — the only documented non-stack; which one wins is UNKNOWN.
Enablers: Poison enables Venom Fang ring; stagger (parry/block, Spectral Echo, Riposte ring) enables Breaker's Band; Ice embrittle makes the next hit kill.
Proc-rate rings (Hexweaver, Blacksmith, Micro Amplifier) bend other layers' proc odds by UNKNOWN amounts — frequency tables are baselines.
First strike x3 vs unaware enemies (official) is NOT placed inside the testers' formula — modelled as a situation toggle outside the chain until placed by measurement.
Outside the hit chain (separate events, never factors): Spectral Echo delayed hit, Poison DoT ticks, Riposte reactive damage.
Whether proc damage can itself crit/proc: UNKNOWN.
Cooldowns/ICDs: none published for any perk. Model assumes NONE (evidence: independent co-triggering rolls; observed frequencies match independent-roll math).

rings.drop: Tomb Extraction only, via crypt sigil codes (same code = same dungeon). Rare + Legendary confirmed.

list.name: Sundering / Armor Penetration
list.note: Reduces armour reduction on ANY location; doubles weak-point damage; testers rate it above the headshot ring

list.factorNote: Own (1+x+y) factor; headshots only; melee + ranged; thrown weapons autotarget head; useless vs Lost Souls and Octoculus boss
list.name: Scout's Signet / Precision Shot

list.factorNote: Bends elemental proc rates by an unknown amount
list.name: Hexweaver / Elemental Boost

list.factorNote: Bends weapon-perk proc rates by an unknown amount
list.name: Blacksmith / Imbued Strength

list.factorNote: Reactive event (outside hit chain): stagger + small return damage
list.name: Duelist / Riposte

list.factorNote: Conditional: attack from behind; does NOT stack with Scout's Signet
list.name: Shadow Strike / Backstab

rings.valueRule: NO numeric value for any ring exists in any public source. Values are printed on each physical ring in-game. In the app every ring value is a USER-ENTERED field with a '?' unknown state. Never ship a default number.

situations: firstStrike (x3 vs unaware — official; placement in formula unconfirmed)
swingStrength (documented to exist, completely unquantified — modelled as execution variance, NOT a calculator input)

perks.name: Criticals
perks.note: No base crit chance without the perk is documented.

perks.name: Throw Damage
perks.note: Thrown attacks only. Spear eligibility is shaky single-source.

perks.name: Stab Damage
perks.note: +50% FLAT, no tier scaling. Stabs/thrusts only. Longsword needs two hands for full benefit.

perks.name: Poison
perks.note: Applies the Poison element effect: slowed, cannot dodge, DoT. Tick damage/rate/duration COMPLETELY UNPUBLISHED.

perks.name: Spectral Echo (aka Spectral Attack)
perks.note: Guaranteed on Spectral-class legendaries (official). Delayed echo hit at x2. Delay and proc chance UNKNOWN; possibly undead-only (official wording unresolved).

perks.name: Reload (crossbows)
perks.note: Non-damage perk, but official patch notes give -7.5% damage per Reload tier. Model the penalty, not the perk.

perks.name: Vampire
perks.note: Heals 25% of PLAYER HEALTH on proc — not damage-based; classified non-damage, excluded from the calculator.

weaponPerks.rules: Max 2 perks per weapon, no duplicates, plus at most one element. %-perks scale +5%/tier across 7 tiers; chance perks 20% + 2%/tier to 32%. NO duration/cooldown/ICD is published for ANY perk.

setAside.note: Research-sourced factors that are NOT part of the owner's calculator (Scott, 2026-10-22). Preserved as a set-aside annex: recorded, never applied by the engine, never deleted. Canonical equation: reference/owner-calculator-formula.md.

factors.name: First strike vs unaware
factors.effect: x3, position in chain unplaced by sources
factors.source: official + community research (superseded as calculator input)
